statement: The separately pinned wiiuse/wiiuse upstream public header exposes a speaker-state flag but no speaker control or data API, and its inspected src/wiiuse.c control functions do not originate reports 0x14, 0x18 or 0x19. This source-bounded absence must not be projected onto the devkitPro/libogc wiiuse fork, whose separately pinned speaker.c and WPAD producer do emit all three speaker reports.
